name: voice-agent-skills
description: Skills for building AI voice agents: provider-neutral voice engineering skills plus dated copies of official provider skills.

plugins.name: voice-foundations
plugins.description: Provider-neutral voice agent skills: stack selection, turn taking, audio, speech pipeline, conversation design, calls, latency, media debugging, evaluation, cost, compliance and security.

plugins.name: voice-livekit
plugins.description: Dated copy of LiveKit's official agent skills (github.com/livekit/agent-skills): build, debug, test, simulate and operate LiveKit agents.

plugins.name: voice-pipecat
plugins.description: Dated copy of Pipecat's official skills (github.com/pipecat-ai/skills): initialize, deploy and talk to Pipecat agents.

plugins.name: voice-elevenlabs
plugins.description: Dated copy of ElevenLabs' official skills (github.com/elevenlabs/skills): agents, text-to-speech, speech-to-text, dubbing, voice changer and isolation.

plugins.name: voice-twilio
plugins.description: Dated copy of Twilio's official voice skills (github.com/twilio/ai): agent architecture, ConversationRelay, TwiML, outbound calls, conferences and recordings.

plugins.name: voice-cartesia
plugins.description: Dated copy of Cartesia's official skills (github.com/cartesia-ai/skills): speech API and Line agents.

plugins.name: voice-openai-speech
plugins.description: Dated copy of OpenAI's speech and transcribe skills (github.com/openai/skills): file-based text-to-speech and transcription.
